verdict.rationale: Token2 is a security-key and authentication vendor, so offering scoped credentials for automated or agent access is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers only local key-management tooling (FIDO2/PIV/TOTP management, Entra ID bulk enrollment via Graph API) and probes found no public API or OpenAPI spec. There is no evidence of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent.
